reviewed_pr_metadata.title: Separate and verify compiler stage boundaries
reviewed_pr_metadata.body:
## Problem

Compiler discovery, finalization and consuming LLVM emission shared one entry point. The first stage split still rendered C adapters during discovery and deferred extension admission until lowering. Full local verification also exposed persistent JIT discovery failures with symlinked LLVM tools.

## Change

Add six guarded, attempt-owned stages and finalized typed-IR inspection. Retain validated C ABI plans until serialization and finish module/export admission before exposing finalized IR. Add finalized-only inspection for the Lean reporter and bind snapshots to reports by hash. A Lean model checks stage order, retries and snapshot association. Canonicalize LLVM library discovery and invalidate stale negative caches. Typing, representation and specialization remain coupled. ChatGPT-assisted implementation and independent agent reviews. Refs #767, #709, #409.

## Validation

Head 5ccd1841 adds actual-ELF regression tests: the old driver fails both, canonicalization alone fails cache migration, and the complete fix passes alongside the existing real-LLVM cache/wrapper test. Fresh bootstrap, corpus, Lean, CI and full local 58-stage qualification are underway. The interrupted run and its pre-existing launcher defect are retained; no full-pass claim is made. [Earlier exact-tree evidence and limitations](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/blob/b0806cea40f358b892604a7af66c5aa661e744f2/research/compiler-stage-completion-2026-11-15/README.md).
